centre-line.name: 1. Centre line
centre-line.note: Thin brown line down the middle, in OSM Carto track rhythms: long dashes = Unpaved, dash-dot = Off-road. Slightly thicker than contour lines.

grain.name: 2. Grain (OSM Carto)
grain.note: Unpaved: the OSM Carto grain, dark dots in the class hue, 1.5 x larger, on a fill tinted a little toward brown. Off-road: big grain added on top.

dashes.name: 3. Dashes
dashes.note: Unpaved: long dashes, dash 3 x and gap 2 x road width (Americana: 4 x and 4 x), darker tint of the class colour (light brown on white). Off-road: dash 2 x, gap 1 x road width.

dashed-casing.name: 4. Dashed casing
dashed-casing.note: Continuous class-coloured fill, dashed outline (as Gaia GPS draws tracks and DMD2 unpaved roads): long dashes = Unpaved, track dash-dot = Off-road, the same rhythm as the centre line.
